_ratchet.py::MIN_REASON.reason: shortest reason or decision text the ratchet accepts; a lower value lets a thin reason pass

defects/test_faker_native_allowlist_tota.reason: smallest literal holding allowlisted names that the total sentry flags; a higher value lets copies of the allowlist pass

dependencies/_faker_lock_lists.py::EN_US.reason: floor on the en_US digest pairs the faker output lock checks; a lower floor lets the lock shrink unnoticed

layout/test_package_fanout.py::LIMIT.reason: direct-module cap per package; a higher cap lets every package hold more modules

release/test_public_census.py::MIN_NAMES.reason: floor on the public names the export census walks; a lower floor lets the walk shrink unnoticed

release/test_public_census.py::MIN_PACKA.reason: floor on the public packages the export census walks; a lower floor lets the walk skip a package unnoticed

release/test_public_signatures.py::HEAD_.reason: floor on the public names the signature census maps; a lower floor lets the census shrink unnoticed

test_module_size.py::GOAL.reason: line count at or under which a module needs no module-size allowlist row; a higher goal loosens every entry

test_module_size.py::MARGIN.reason: headroom a fresh dense pin starts with; a higher margin lets a ceiling sit above its module

test_module_size.py::MAX.reason: hard line ceiling for new work; a higher value lets a module grow past the reviewed cap

test_outbound_clients.py::WALK_FLOOR.reason: floor on the files the outbound-client walk sees; a lower floor lets the walk shrink unnoticed
